name: Dimensional Seal (Su)
category: Arcanist Greater Exploits – Jon Brazer Enterprises
body:
The arcanist can expend 1 point from her arcane reservoir to emanate a field centered on herself which blocks dimensional travel—including summoning and teleportation effects, as well as the dimensional slide exploit—in a radius of 5 feet per arcanist level for a number of minutes equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1). She may dismiss this effect at will. The arcanist must have the dimensional slide exploit to select this greater exploit.

Book of Magic: 10 Arcanist Exploits, © 2016, Jon Brazer Enterprises
